task.title: DialogContent likely shares the sheet compositor flash
task.description: Sibling of WB-01M0DT5XSA (2026-08-20, fixed for Sheet via data-[state=open]:will-change-transform on SheetContent): DialogContent has the same shape (transition-all duration-200 + data-[state=open]:scale-100/opacity-100) and plausibly de-promotes the same way on the Android System WebView, but every Dialog surface is authed and unreachable over the dev-webview attach, so it could not be measured. Trigger: Dylan reports flashing when an authed dialog (e.g. move/which-copies) opens on his phone — then apply the same state-keyed will-change hint and verify on-device. Mechanism + A/B method recorded in specs/app-ui.md Findings.
